name: Stormbringer: Hurricanes buffs the caster when Unshackle is cast (#1773)

steps.label: SETUP: Unshackle needs the Air Elemental, its only target
BASELINE: Hurricanes' buff 570129 is absent before Unshackle is cast
SETUP: Unshackle reached its target and applied its aura
DISCRIMINATING: casting Unshackle procs Hurricanes, applying 570129 to the caster
DISCRIMINATING: the 15% reaches damage done, so Shock hits for 1.15x its unbuffed value

contract: #1773: Hurricanes (300839) reads "Casting Unshackle now unshackles you, increasing your damage dealt by $570129s1% for $570129d", i.e. 15% for 15 sec: 570129 has EffectBasePoints[0] 14 + EffectDieSides[0] 1 = 15 on SPELL_AURA_MOD_DAMAGE_PERCENT_DONE and DurationIndex 8 = 15000 ms. Unshackle (706625) is the only SpellFamilyName 22 record with SpellFamilyFlags[0] bit 16, is SPELL_DAMAGE_CLASS_NONE and positive, so its cast raises PROC_FLAG_DONE_SPELL_NONE_DMG_CLASS_POS with SpellTypeMask PROC_SPELL_TYPE_NO_DMG_HEAL in the hit phase. The buff's school mask is empty in Spell.dbc, so the tooltip's unqualified "damage dealt" is delivered as SPELL_SCHOOL_MASK_ALL, the same value Unshackle's own damage aura uses. Shock (804020) is a Nature Stormbringer nuke and the ratio makes the assertion independent of the character's stats.
